column79: The Leila and Afric pearling luggers were caught by the cyclone off Oxley Island. The Leila was blown across to the vicinity of Cape Croker where conditions became dead calm. The crew survived but the Afric and six crew were lost.

Six of the 15 crew of the JaneB drowned after setting out from Trepang Bay on the Cobourg Peninsula and running into the full force of the cyclone. Two other pearling luggers; the Opal and Harriet (three crew) went missing.

Buildings on Bathurst and Melville Islands were damaged. The barometer dropped ten millibars in half an hour and the wind blew with great violence between 1 am and noon 9CST. Much of the timber and trees were stripped of their foliage.
